user.title: Menstrual Cycle Companion
user.description: Create a profile (username + friendly name) for cycle tracking.

error.invalid_profile: Profile must contain letters or numbers.

init.title: Menstrual Cycle Companion Settings
init.description: Adjust cycle tracking settings. Changes are saved immediately.

data_description.period_duration_days: Number of days the period typically lasts (1–14).
data_description.pregnancy_enabled: Activates pregnancy tracking mode. The pregnancy start date is auto-filled from the last cycle start if left empty.
data_description.pregnancy_start_date: First day of last menstruation (LMP). Leave empty to use the last recorded cycle start.
data_description.pre_menarche_enabled: Track puberty signs before the first period (menarche).
data_description.estimated_menarche_date: Estimated date of the first period. Used for countdown tracking.
data_description.family_menarche_age: Age of menarche in the family (mother/sister) used to estimate the expected age.
data_description.menopause_start_date: Date when menopause started (YYYY-MM-DD). Leave empty if unknown.
data_description.cycle_length_override: Override the automatically calculated average cycle length. Set to 0 to use the auto-calculated value from your history (recommended). Set to 20–38 to manually fix the cycle length used for fertile window and ovulation calculations.
data_description.nfp_analysis_mode: Controls how ovulation and the fertile window are calculated. 'hybrid' (default) learns from observed temperature data and falls back to the statistical formula. 'strict' only shows ovulation and the fertile window when a temperature rise is confirmed in the current cycle.
data_description.num_predictions: How many future cycle starts to generate (1-12). Default is 6.

error.invalid_date: Invalid date format. Please use YYYY-MM-DD.
error.invalid_menarche_age: Age must be a number between 8 and 20.

add_cycle_start.name: Add cycle start day
add_cycle_start.description: Add one confirmed bleeding day in YYYY-MM-DD format.

remove_cycle_start.name: Remove cycle start day
remove_cycle_start.description: Remove one confirmed bleeding day in YYYY-MM-DD format.

set_cycle_range.name: Set cycle date range
set_cycle_range.description: Add every confirmed bleeding day from start_date through end_date, inclusive.

set_cycle_history.name: Replace full cycle history
set_cycle_history.description: Replace complete confirmed bleeding history with a list of dates.

set_period_duration.name: Set period duration days
set_period_duration.description: Set forecasted period duration (used for card markers).

erase_all_history.name: Erase all cycle history
erase_all_history.description:
Destructive action. Deletes the complete stored history.
Safety checks:
- works only when `erase_all` is exactly `true`
- requires explicit `entity_id` (sensor id)
This helps prevent accidental destructive calls (e.g. shell command without target).

export_history.name: Export cycle history
export_history.description:
Exports the current history to a local file.
Files are written to `<config>/menstrual_cycle_companion_exports/`.
Supported formats: `csv`, `txt`.

refresh_cycle_model.name: Refresh cycle model
refresh_cycle_model.description: Recalculate all date-based sensor values, including days until next predicted start.

log_product_usage.name: Log product usage
log_product_usage.description: Log period-product usage for timer integrations and long-term statistics.

action.name: Action
action.description: Usage action, for example used or emptied.

quantity.name: Quantity
quantity.description: How many products or emptying events to add.

date.name: Date
date.description: Optional ISO date to backfill. Defaults to today.

manage_household_inventory.name: Manage household inventory
manage_household_inventory.description: Manage shared household stock for tampons, pads, cups, liners, and period underwear.

member.name: Member
member.description: Name of the household member for manual consumption logs.

underwear_total_owned.name: Underwear Total Owned
underwear_total_owned.description: Total number of period underwear pieces owned (used to calculate availability and washing alerts).

add_symptom.name: Add or update symptom data for a date
add_symptom.description: Add or update symptom data for a specific date. Data is merged with existing entries.

symptom_data.name: Symptom Data
symptom_data.description: Dictionary with symptom fields. Optional fields - bleeding_strength, spotting, intercourse, pain (list), basal_temp (number), hygiene (list), test

remove_symptom.name: Remove symptom data for a date
remove_symptom.description: Remove all symptom data for a specific date.

get_symptom.name: Get symptom data for a date
get_symptom.description: Retrieve symptom data for a specific date.

set_pregnancy_mode.name: Set pregnancy mode
set_pregnancy_mode.description: Enable or disable pregnancy mode. When enabled, the sensor reports pregnancy state with weeks pregnant and due date.

is_pregnant.name: Is Pregnant
is_pregnant.description: Set to true to enable pregnancy mode, false to disable.

pregnancy_start_date.name: Pregnancy Start Date
pregnancy_start_date.description: First day of last menstrual period (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to last known period start.

update_pregnancy_date.name: Update pregnancy start date
update_pregnancy_date.description: Update the first day of the last menstrual period used for pregnancy calculations.

pregnancy_start_date.name: Pregnancy Start Date
pregnancy_start_date.description: First day of last menstrual period in YYYY-MM-DD format.

set_menarche_mode.name: Set menarche mode
set_menarche_mode.description: Enable pre-menarche tracking or confirm that menarche has occurred. Use this for tracking puberty signs before the first period.

is_menarche.name: Is Menarche
is_menarche.description: Set to false to enable pre-menarche tracking, true when menarche has occurred.

estimated_menarche_date.name: Estimated Menarche Date
estimated_menarche_date.description: Estimated date when menarche is expected (YYYY-MM-DD).

family_menarche_age.name: Family Menarche Age
family_menarche_age.description: Age of menarche in the family (e.g. mother, sister), used for estimation.

update_menarche_date.name: Update menarche date
update_menarche_date.description: Record the actual date when menarche (first period) occurred.

log_first_period.name: Log first period
log_first_period.description: Atomically records menarche date and adds the first cycle start. Use this to transition a profile out of Pre-Menarche mode when the first period begins.

get_menarche_info.name: Get menarche information
get_menarche_info.description: Retrieve menarche and pre-menarche tracking data for a profile.

add_pre_menarche_sign.name: Add pre-menarche body sign
add_pre_menarche_sign.description: Record or update a puberty body sign for pre-menarche tracking (Tanner stage classification).

tanner_stage.name: Tanner Stage
tanner_stage.description: Current stage or level for the selected sign.

remove_pre_menarche_sign.name: Remove pre-menarche body sign
remove_pre_menarche_sign.description: Remove a recorded puberty body sign from pre-menarche tracking.

set_menopause_mode.name: Set menopause mode
set_menopause_mode.description: Enable or disable menopause tracking mode.

is_menopause.name: Is Menopause
is_menopause.description: Set to true to activate menopause mode, false to deactivate.

save_timer_state.name: Save timer state
save_timer_state.description:
Persist the current countdown timer state (remaining time, selected product,
running/paused) so it survives page reloads and is available on other devices.
Called automatically by the Period Countdown Timer card.

remaining_seconds.name: Remaining Seconds
remaining_seconds.description: Remaining countdown seconds at the time of saving.

total_seconds.name: Total Seconds
total_seconds.description: Total countdown duration in seconds for the selected product.

selected_product.name: Selected Product
selected_product.description: Currently selected product key (tampon, pad, cup, liner, underwear).

is_running.name: Is Running
is_running.description: Whether the timer was actively running when the state was saved.

saved_at.name: Saved At
saved_at.description: JavaScript Date.now() millisecond timestamp when the state was saved. Used to calculate elapsed time when restoring a running timer.

export_doctor_report.name: Export doctor report (HTML)
export_doctor_report.description:
Generates a professional HTML medical report from the cycle history and symptom data.
The file is saved to `<config>/menstrual_cycle_companion_exports/`.
Open the file in a browser and use "Print to PDF" to create a PDF.

days_back.name: Days Back
days_back.description: Number of days to include in the report (30–730). Default is 180 (6 months).

patient_name.name: Patient Name
patient_name.description: Patient name to include in the report header (optional).

patient_birthdate.name: Patient Birthdate
patient_birthdate.description: Patient date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format (optional).

language.name: Language
language.description: Report language. "de" for German, "en" for English. Default is "de".
